query: SELECT ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome, ls.equipamentoId, SUM(ls.valor) as total FROM lancamento_salario ls JOIN conta_custo cc ON ls.contaCustoId = cc.id WHERE ls.periodoCustoId = 60001 AND ls.equipamentoId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome, ls.equipamentoId ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
